title: Box That Head
description: Contestants choose one of three boxes to be placed on their head. Two boxes contain pleasant things, and one, not so pleasant. If they survive four rounds of boxes, they win $50,000.
altHero: two women helpers holding a box labeled 2 over the head of a teen boy
alt1: contestant talking to the host and looking at 3 numbered boxes
alt2: host looking at what’s inside box #3
alt3: box 2 being removed from contestant’s head and his face is covered in welts
tags: game shows with a bit of danger!
